verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a PR-history mechanism that learns from the team's pull request activity to judge what matters in a review (qodo-docs-48). Relevance scoring rates new findings by how the team handled similar findings in past PRs (qodo-docs-53), and Rule Miner generates enforceable rules from PR history into a centralized rule system (qodo-docs-13, qodo-docs-12), which together cover both past decisions and team conventions being applied to future PRs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the learning works in practice, and detailed documentation of how dismissals and discussions update the stored memory over time.
